ruleset.name: lift-trax-test-source-analysis
ruleset.description: Size and complexity ratchets for maintained test sources. The focused rules avoid applying production style opinions to test fixtures while still preventing oversized or overly complex tests.

property.name: violationSuppressXPath
property.value: self::ClassDeclaration[@SimpleName = 'WebServerCliTest'] | ./ancestor-or-self::MethodDeclaration[ (ancestor::ClassDeclaration[@SimpleName = 'CatalogRecoveryDrillTest'] and @Name = 'drill' and count(FormalParameters/FormalParameter) = 3) or (ancestor::ClassDeclaration[@SimpleName = 'HttpsProxyIntegrationTest'] and @Name = 'trustedTlsPreservesAuthenticationIsolationCsrfAndWorkoutSubmission' and count(FormalParameters/FormalParameter) = 0) or (ancestor::ClassDeclaration[@SimpleName = 'PlannedWorkoutSessionHtmlTest'] and @Name = 'sessionPageStartsWithEmptyCompletedSetsAndAllowsWorkoutFileSwaps' and count(FormalParameters/FormalParameter) = 0) or (ancestor::ClassDeclaration[@SimpleName = 'WebServerCliTest'] and @Name = 'renderTaskLayoutKeepsSecondaryViewsAndExistingFlows' and count(FormalParameters/FormalParameter) = 0) ]

rule.name: ExcessivePhysicalTestClassLength
rule.message: Test class spans more than 1000 physical lines.
rule.description: Counts the complete test class source span, including fixture text blocks.

rule.name: ExcessivePhysicalTestMethodLength
rule.message: Test method or constructor spans more than 100 physical lines.
rule.description: Counts the complete declaration span, including maintained fixture text blocks.
